datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly basis throughout 2014, classifying geographic areas in Zimbabwe by food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats representing different scenarios and time periods (January, April, July, October 2014) to document the evolving food security situation.
